args.sql:
DO $do$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT FROM information_schema.tables
        WHERE table_name = 'container_tss_monitoring'
    ) THEN
        CREATE TABLE container_tss_monitoring (
            containregistry VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,
            latest_tss REAL,
            last_updated TIMESTAMP
        );
    END IF;
END $do$;

WITH tss_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        containlink,
        (1 - (tempdevcount / 100.0)) * (1 - (critevents / 10.0)) * tempstabidx AS tss
    FROM sensordata
),
update_tss AS (
    UPDATE container_tss_monitoring ctm
    SET
        latest_tss = tc.tss,
        last_updated = NOW()
    FROM tss_calculation tc
    WHERE ctm.containregistry = tc.containlink
    RETURNING ctm.containregistry
),
insert_tss AS (
    INSERT INTO container_tss_monitoring (
        containregistry,
        latest_tss,
        last_updated
    )
    SELECT
        tc.containlink,
        tc.tss,
        NOW()
    FROM tss_calculation tc
    LEFT JOIN update_tss uts
    ON tc.containlink = uts.containregistry
    WHERE uts.containregistry IS NULL
)
SELECT 'Table updated successfully' AS result;
